updateNote: 2026-12-07 から Exam Guide v1.1 の出題範囲（7ドメイン・39 skill・70問）。シナリオ名は公開されていないので、問題はそれぞれ独立した業務場面の単一選択・複数選択。Foundations（CCAO-F・CCDV-F）の範囲は前提知識として扱われる。
competencies: Designing end-to-end Claude solutions: delegating work between Claude and humans, selecting architectural patterns, decomposing orchestrators and subagents, and choosing the deployment surface and agent runtime
Selecting model tiers, diagnosing system prompts, choosing prompting techniques, and managing context, caching, reasoning effort, and context lifecycle
Integrating Claude with least-privilege tools, sound authentication and authorization, retrieval, connection mechanisms, monitoring, and production reliability controls
Deriving evaluations from business processes, designing LLM-as-judge and configuration experiments, isolating root causes, optimizing cost and latency, and migrating model versions
Placing guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints, controlling prompt injection, ranking risks, meeting compliance obligations, and mitigating bias
Communicating with stakeholders through supportable commitments, architecture decision records, and complete operational handoffs
Enabling developers by packaging Claude Code workflows, configuring the Agent SDK and Claude Code safely, and keeping humans accountable for AI-generated code
